response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.av

assumptions.assumption: The average count is taken over the sides that appear after the inner join, so sides with no matched risk/margin records are not included in the average.
orders.recordvault is unique per order, so the join does not duplicate rows. A NULL dealedge, if present, would be treated as its own side.
